news.title: UNI’s Metal Casting Center partners with METAL to provide workforce training in casting and forging for K-12 students and professionals
news.summary_en: The UNI Metal Casting Center is proud to announce a partnership with the Metallurgical Engineering Trades Apprenticeship & Learning program, led by IACMI – The Composites Institute®, to enhance and scale up industry-driven training opportunities for current and prospective metalworking and manufacturing professionals.
